title: Web app: show the member count on the workspace page
whatToBuild: Web app: a team member opening the workspace page sees how many members the workspace has, read from the workspace service.
testBoundaries: the workspace service's getWorkspace and GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug through their exports in apps/web/test/ with node:test, asserting on memberCount (issue 01's tests); the page is checked in the running web app

acceptanceCriteria.text: The web workspace page shows the member count under the member's role
Checked in the running web app
